flaws.A: Has the most dynamic lunge, but the raised sword is cropped in frame 1 and the oversized settle frame pops back to idle.
flaws.C: Muddy tan patches on the shorts through the swing, and the contact pose is too upright to sell the hit.
flaws.E: The cleanest colours of the four, but the wind-up is weak and almost the same pose as the anticipation frame.
flaws.G: Has the best wind-up and a seamless settle, but tan smudges stain the shorts and the contact frame does not drop the body.

strike.notes: All four keep the sword in the right hand and the shield on the left arm. The main differences are the wind-up, how far the body drops on contact, and the colour noise.
